0.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_000
0.description: Welcome to Byron's Bread. Come to buy some of our produce, have you?
0.translation_description: Benvenuto al Pane di Byron. Sei qui per acquistare i nostri prodotti agricoli?

3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_010
5.description: I keep myself busy farming these lands. Although, it's hardly the most fertile of soil, and every year the harvest worsens... Some days I just want to give up.
5.translation_description: Lavoro sodo coltivando questi terreni. Eppure il suolo è tutt’altro che fertile e il raccolto peggiora di anno in anno... A volte vorrei solo gettare la spugna.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_011
6.description: That being said, it's not as if we can all float on working at the quarry like the old days.
6.translation_description: Detto questo, non possiamo certo vivere tutti del lavoro in cava come ai vecchi tempi.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_012
7.description: No, we'd all be better served looking towards the future. Our children would not thank us for clinging to the past.
7.translation_description: No, faremmo meglio a guardare al futuro. I nostri figli non ci ringrazierebbero se restassimo aggrappati al passato.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_020
8.description: It's a farm created by my grandfather, Byron. When the quarrying industry began to decline, he chose to become a farmer, so he could keep providing for his family.
8.translation_description: È una fattoria fondata da mio nonno Byron. Quando l’attività estrattiva cominciò a declinare, scelse di diventare agricoltore per continuare a mantenere la famiglia.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_021
9.description: The name “Byron's Bread” came to be after the villagers developed a saying: every mother in Ala Gannha knows their bread is buttered by Byron.
9.translation_description: Il nome «Il Pane di Byron» nacque da un detto popolare: ogni madre di Ala Gannha sa che il pane da mettere in tavola arriva grazie a Byron.

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_022
10.description: Grandpa actually passed away before he managed to reap his first harvest. He left the farm to Father and me, and we did our best to make it a success.
10.translation_description: Il nonno morì prima di poter raccogliere il suo primo raccolto. Lasciò la fattoria a mio padre e a me, e facemmo del nostro meglio per farla prosperare.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3BYRONSBREAD_00398_IMMODESTMOUSE_000_023
11.description: I'll never forget what Grandpa did for us. His blood and sweat cultivated this land; I would disgrace his memory were I to abandon it.
11.translation_description: Non dimenticherò mai ciò che il nonno fece per noi. Ha coltivato questa terra con il suo sangue e il suo sudore; se l’abbandonassi, ne disonorerei la memoria.
